verses.text: For dat time, Herod di tetrarch hear di report about Jesus,
and talk say to im servants, “Dis na John di Baptizer. E don rise from di dead. Na why dis powers dey work inside am.”
Because Herod don arrest John, and bind am, and put am for prison because of Herodias, im brother Philip wife.
Because John talk say to am, “E no lawful for you to have am.”
When e want put am to death, e fear di multitude, because dem count am as prophet.
But when Herod birthday come, di daughter of Herodias dance among dem and please Herod.
So e promise with oath to give am whatever e go ask.
As im mama prompt am, e talk say, “Give me here for platter di head of John di Baptizer.”
Di king dey sorrowful, but because of im oaths, and of dem wey dey sit for di table with am, e command say make dem give am,
and e send and behead John for di prison.
Dem bring im head for platter, and give am to di young lady: and e bring am to im mama.
Im disciples come, and take di body, and bury am; and dem leave go tell Jesus.
Now when Jesus hear dis, e withdraw from dat place for boat, enter deserted place apart. When di multitudes hear am, dem follow am on foot from di cities.
Jesus come out, and e see great multitude. E get compassion for dem, and heal dem wey sick.

When evening don come, im disciples come to am, and talk say, “Dis place dey deserted, and di hour don late already. Send di multitudes away, so that dem go enter di villages, and buy food for demself.”
But Jesus talk say to dem, “Dem no need to go away. Una give dem something to eat.”
Dem tell am, “We only get five loaves and two fish for here.”
E talk say, “Bring dem here to me.”

E command di multitudes to sit down for di grass; and e take di five loaves and di two fish, and look up to heaven, e bless, break and give di loaves to di disciples, and di disciples give to di multitudes.
Dem all eat, and dem full. Dem pick up 12 baskets full of di broken pieces wey remain.
Dem wey eat na about 5,000 men, apart from women and pikin dem.
Immediately Jesus make di disciples enter di boat, and go ahead of am go di other side, while e dey send di multitudes away.
After e don send di multitudes away, e go up enter di mountain by imself to pray. When evening don come, e dey for dat place alone.
But di boat dey for di middle of di sea now, di waves dey trouble am, because di wind dey against dem.
For di fourth watch of di night, Jesus come to dem, dey walk on di sea.
When di disciples see am dey walk on di sea, dem dey troubled, dey talk say, “Na ghost!” and dem cry out for fear.
But immediately Jesus talk say to dem, “Cheer up! Na me! No fear.”
Peter answer am and talk say, “Lord, if na you, command me to come to you on di waters.”
E talk say, “Come!” Peter step down from di boat, and walk on di waters to come to Jesus.
But when e see say di wind strong, e fear, and as e begin to sink, e cry out, and talk say, “Lord, save me!”
Immediately Jesus stretch out im hand, and hold am, and talk say to am, “You wey get small faith, why you doubt?”
When dem enter di boat, di wind stop.
Dem wey dey inside di boat come and worship am, dey talk say, “Truly na you be God Pikin!”
When dem don cross over, dem come to di land of Gennesaret.
When di men of dat place recognize am, dem send enter all dat surrounding region, and bring to am all wey sick,
and dem beg am make dem just touch di fringe of im garment. Everybody wey touch am dey made whole.
Den Pharisees and scribes come to Jesus from Jerusalem, and talk say,
“Why your disciples dey disobey di tradition of di elders? Because dem no dey wash dem hands when dem dey eat bread.”
E answer dem, “Why una too dey disobey di commandment of God because of una tradition?”
“Because God command, ‘Honor your papa and your mama,’ and, ‘Di one wey talk evil of papa or mama, make dem put am to death.’”
“But una talk say, ‘Whoever go tell im papa or im mama, Anything wey you for fit get from me as help na gift wey I don devote to God,’”
“‘E no go honor im papa or mama.’ Una don make di commandment of God void because of una tradition.”
“Una hypocrites! Isaiah prophesy well about una, and talk say,”
“‘Dis people dey draw near to me with dem mouth, and dey honor me with dem lips; but dem heart far from me.’”
“‘But for vain dem dey worship me, dey teach commandments of men as doctrines.’”
E call di multitude, and talk say to dem, “Hear, and understand.”
“Wetin dey enter di mouth no dey defile di man; but wetin dey come out from di mouth, na dat one dey defile di man.”
Den im disciples come, and talk say to am, “You know say di Pharisees take offense, when dem hear dis saying?”
But e answer, “Every plant wey my Papa God wey dey heaven no plant, dem go uproot am.”
“Leave dem alone. Dem na blind guides of di blind. If di blind dey guide di blind, both go fall enter pit.”
Peter answer am, “Explain di parable to us.”
So Jesus talk say, “Una still no get understanding too?”
“Una no understand say whatever dey enter di mouth dey pass enter di belly, and den go out from di body?”
“But di things wey dey come out from di mouth dey come out from di heart, and dem dey defile di man.”
“Because from di heart evil thoughts dey come, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.”
“Dem na di things wey dey defile di man; but to eat with unwashed hands no dey defile di man.”
Jesus leave dat place, and withdraw enter di region of Tyre and Sidon.
Look, Canaanite woman come out from dat border, and cry, and talk say, “Show me mercy, Lord, you David pikin! My daughter dey severely possessed by evil spirit.”
But e no answer am one word. Im disciples come and beg am, and talk say, “Send am away; because e dey cry after us.”
But e answer, “Dem no send me to anybody except di lost sheep of di house of Israel.”
But e come and worship am, and talk say, “Lord, help me.”
But e answer, “E no appropriate to take di pikin dem bread and throw am to di dogs.”
But e talk say, “Yes, Lord, but even di dogs dey eat di crumbs wey fall from dem oga dem table.”
Den Jesus answer am, “Woman, your faith great! Make am happen to you as you desire.” And im daughter dey healed from dat hour.
Jesus leave dat place, and come near di sea of Galilee; and e go up enter di mountain, and sit for dat place.
Great multitudes come to am, wey get di lame, blind, mute, maimed, and plenty others with dem, and dem put dem down for im feet. E heal dem,
so tay di multitude wonder when dem see di mute dey talk, di injured dey whole, di lame dey walk, and di blind dey see; and dem glorify di God of Israel.

Jesus call im disciples and talk say, “I get compassion for di multitude, because dem don stay with me three days now, and dem no get anything to eat. I no want send dem away without food, or dem go faint for di way.”
Di disciples talk say to am, “Wia we go get so plenty loaves for deserted place to satisfy so great multitude?”
Jesus talk say to dem, “How many loaves una get?” Dem talk say, “Seven, and few small fish.”
E command di multitude to sit down for di ground;
and e take di seven loaves and di fish. E give thanks and break dem, and give to di disciples, and di disciples give to di multitudes.
Dem all eat, and dem full. Dem pick up seven baskets full of di broken pieces wey remain.
Dem wey eat na 4,000 men, apart from women and pikin dem.
Den e send di multitudes away, enter di boat, and come reach di borders of Magdala.
Di Pharisees and Sadducees come, and dey test am, dem ask am to show dem sign from heaven.
But e answer dem, “When evening reach, una dey talk say, ‘Fair weather go dey, because di sky red.’”
“For morning, ‘Foul weather go dey today, because di sky red and overcast.’ Hypocrites! Una know how to discern di appearance of di sky, but una no fit discern di signs of di times!”
“Evil and adulterous generation dey seek sign, and dem no go give am sign, except di sign of di prophet Jonah.” E leave dem, and go.
Di disciples come to di other side and don forget to take bread.
Jesus talk say to dem, “Take heed and beware of di yeast of di Pharisees and Sadducees.”
Dem reason among demself, and talk say, “We no bring bread.”
Jesus perceive am, and talk say, “Una wey get small faith, why una dey reason among una self, because una no bring bread?”
“Una never perceive, and una no remember di five loaves for di 5,000, and how many baskets una pick up?”
“Or di seven loaves for di 4,000, and how many baskets una pick up?”
“How e be say una no perceive say I no talk to una about bread? But beware of di yeast of di Pharisees and Sadducees.”
Den dem understand say e no tell dem to beware of di yeast of bread, but of di teaching of di Pharisees and Sadducees.
Now when Jesus come enter di parts of Caesarea Philippi, e ask im disciples, “Who men dey talk say I, Son of Man, be?”
Dem talk say, “Some talk say John di Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of di prophets.”
E talk say to dem, “But who una talk say I be?”
Simon Peter answer, “You na Christ, di Pikin of di living God.”
Jesus answer am, “Blessed na you, Simon Bar Jonah, because flesh and blood no reveal am to you, but my Papa God wey dey heaven.”
“I also tell you say you na Peter, and on dis rock I go build my church, and di gates of Hades no go prevail against am.”
“I go give you di keys of Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you go bind for earth go don bind for heaven, and whatever you go release for earth go don release for heaven.”
Den e command di disciples say dem no go tell anybody say na Jesus Christ.

From dat time, Jesus begin to show im disciples say e must go to Jerusalem and suffer plenty things from di elders, chief priests, and scribes, and dem go kill am, and for di third day dem go raise am up.
Peter take am aside, and begin to rebuke am, and talk say, “Make dat thing dey far from you, Lord! Dem no go ever do dis to you.”
But e turn, and talk say to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You na stumbling block to me, because you no dey set your mind for di things of God, but for di things of men.”
Den Jesus talk say to im disciples, “If anybody want come after me, make e deny imself, and take up im cross, and follow me.”
“Because whoever want save im life go lose am, and whoever go lose im life because of me go find am.”
“Because wetin e go profit man, if e gain di whole world, and lose im life? Or wetin man go give in exchange for im life?”
“Because Son of Man go come for di glory of im Papa God with im angels, and den e go render to everyone according to im deeds.”
“Most certainly I tell una, some dey stand here wey no go taste death at all, until dem see Son of Man dey come for im Kingdom.”
After six days, Jesus take Peter, James, and John im brother with am, and bring dem up enter high mountain by demself.
E change before dem. Im face shine like di sun, and im garments become white like di light.
Look, Moses and Elijah appear to dem dey talk with am.
Peter answer, and talk say to Jesus, “Lord, e good for us to dey here. If you want, make we make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
While e still dey talk, look, bright cloud overshadow dem. Look, voice come out from di cloud, and talk say, “Dis na my beloved Pikin, wey I dey well pleased with. Listen to am.”
When di disciples hear am, dem fall on dem faces, and dem dey very afraid.
Jesus come and touch dem and talk say, “Get up, and no fear.”
When dem lift up dem eyes, dem no see anybody, except Jesus alone.
As dem dey come down from di mountain, Jesus command dem, and talk say, “Tell di vision to nobody until Son of Man don rise from di dead.”
Im disciples ask am, and talk say, “Den why di scribes dey talk say Elijah must come first?”
Jesus answer dem, “Elijah indeed dey come first, and e go restore all things.”
“But I tell una say Elijah don come already, and dem no recognize am, but dem do am whatever dem want. Even so Son of Man go also suffer by dem.”
Den di disciples understand say e talk to dem about John di Baptizer.
When dem come to di multitude, man come to am, kneel down to am, and talk say,
“Lord, show mercy on my son, because e get epilepsy, and e dey suffer terribly; because e dey fall enter di fire often, and often enter di water.”
“So I bring am to your disciples, and dem no fit cure am.”
Jesus answer, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long I go dey with una? How long I go bear with una? Bring am here to me.”
Jesus rebuke di evil spirit, and e come out from am, and di boy don cure from dat hour.
Den di disciples come to Jesus privately, and talk say, “Why we no fit cast am out?”

E talk say to dem, “Because of una unbelief. Because most certainly I tell una, if una get faith like grain of mustard seed, una go talk say to dis mountain, ‘Move from here go dat place,’ and e go move; and nothing go impossible for una.”
“But dis kind no dey go out except by prayer and fasting.”
While dem dey stay for Galilee, Jesus talk say to dem, “Son of Man go dey handed over into di hands of men,”
“And dem go kill am, and for di third day dem go raise am up.” Dem dey very sorrowful.
When dem don come to Capernaum, dem wey dey collect di didrachma coins come to Peter, and talk say, “Your teacher no dey pay di didrachma?”

E talk say, “Yes.” When e enter di house, Jesus talk first to am, and talk say, “Wetin you think, Simon? From who di kings of di earth dey receive toll or tribute? From dem pikin dem, or from strangers?”
Peter talk say to am, “From strangers.” Jesus talk say to am, “So di pikin dem no dey owe.”

“But, so that we no go make dem stumble, go to di sea, throw hook, and take up di first fish wey come up. When you don open im mouth, you go find stater coin. Take am, and give am to dem for me and you.”
For dat hour di disciples come to Jesus, and talk say, “Who be di greatest for Kingdom of Heaven?”
Jesus call small pikin to imself, and set am for di middle of dem,
and talk say, “Most certainly I tell una, unless una turn, and become like small pikin dem, una no go enter Kingdom of Heaven at all.”
“So whoever humble imself like dis small pikin, na im be di greatest for Kingdom of Heaven.”
“Whoever receive one small pikin like dis for my name receive me,”
“but whoever make one of dis small ones wey believe inside me stumble, e go better for am say dem hang huge millstone round im neck, and say dem sink am for di depths of di sea.”
“Woe dey for di world because of things wey dey make people stumble! Because e must be say dem things go come, but woe dey for dat person wey dem come through!”

“If your hand or your foot dey make you stumble, cut am off, and throw am away from you. E better for you to enter life maimed or crippled, than to get two hands or two feet and dem throw you enter di fire wey no dey end.”
“If your eye dey make you stumble, pluck am out, and throw am away from you. E better for you to enter life with one eye, than to get two eyes and dem throw you enter di fire of Gehenna.”
“See say una no despise one of dis small ones, because I tell una say for heaven dem angels dey always see di face of my Papa God wey dey heaven.”
“Because Son of Man come to save wetin dem don lose.”
“Wetin una think? If man get 100 sheep, and one of dem wander away, e no go leave di 99, go to di mountains, and seek di one wey wander away?”
“If e find am, most certainly I tell una, e dey rejoice over am more pass di 99 wey never wander away.”
“Even so e no be di will of una Papa God wey dey heaven, say one of dis small ones go perish.”
“If your brother sin against you, go, show am im fault between you and am alone. If e listen to you, you don gain your brother back.”
“But if e no listen, take one or two more with you, so that for di mouth of two or three witnesses every word go dey established.”
“If e refuse to hear dem, tell am to di church. If e refuse to hear di church too, make e be to you like Gentile or tax collector.”
“Most certainly I tell una, whatever things una go bind for earth go dey bound for heaven, and whatever things una go release for earth go dey released for heaven.”
“Again, I tell una for sure, say if two of una go agree for earth about anything wey dem go ask, my Papa God wey dey heaven go do am for dem.”
“Because wia two or three gather together for my name, na for dat place I dey for di middle of dem.”
Den Peter come and talk say to am, “Lord, how often my brother go sin against me, and I go forgive am? Until seven times?”
Jesus talk say to am, “I no tell you until seven times, but, until 70 times seven.”
“So Kingdom of Heaven be like one king, wey want settle accounts with im servants.”
“When e begin to settle, dem bring one to am wey owe am 10,000 talents.”
“But because e no fit pay, im oga command say make dem sell am, with im wife, im pikin dem, and all wey e get, and make payment dey made.”
“Di servant fall down and kneel before am, and talk say, ‘Oga, get patience with me, and I go pay you all!’”
“Di oga of dat servant, as compassion move am, release am, and forgive am di debt.”
“But dat servant come out, and find one of im fellow servants, wey owe am 100 denarii, and e grab am, and hold am by di throat, and talk say, ‘Pay me wetin you owe!’”
“So im fellow servant fall down for im feet and beg am, and talk say, ‘Get patience with me, and I go pay you!’”
“E refuse, but e leave go throw am enter prison, until e go pay back wetin e owe.”
“So when im fellow servants see wetin happen, dem dey very sorry, and dem come and tell dem oga all wetin happen.”
“Den im oga call am in, and talk say to am, ‘You wicked servant! I forgive you all dat debt, because you beg me.’”
“‘You no suppose get mercy on your fellow servant too, even as I get mercy on you?’”
“Im oga dey angry, and hand am over to di tormentors, until e go pay all wetin e owe am.”
“So my Papa God wey dey heaven go also do to una, if every one of una no forgive im brother from una hearts for im misdeeds.”
When Jesus don finish dis words, e leave Galilee, and come to di borders of Judea beyond di Jordan.
Great multitudes follow am, and e heal dem for dat place.
Some Pharisees come to am, dey test am, and talk say, “E lawful for man to divorce im wife for any reason?”
E answer, “Una never read say di one wey make dem from di beginning make dem male and female,”
“and talk say, ‘Because of dis cause man go leave im papa and mama, and go join to im wife; and di two go become one flesh?’”
“So dem no be two again, but one flesh. So wetin God don join together, make nobody separate.”
Dem ask am, “Why den Moses command us to give am certificate of divorce, and divorce am?”
E talk say to dem, “Moses, because of di hardness of una hearts, allow una to divorce una wives, but from di beginning e no be so.”
“I tell una say whoever divorce im wife, except for sexual immorality, and marry another, dey commit adultery; and di one wey marry di one wey dem divorce dey commit adultery.”
Im disciples talk say to am, “If di case of di man be so with im wife, e no good to marry.”
But e talk say to dem, “No be all men fit receive dis saying, but only dem wey dem give am to.”

“Because eunuchs dey wey dem born so from dem mama womb. Eunuchs dey wey men make eunuchs. Eunuchs dey wey make demself eunuchs because of Kingdom of Heaven. Di one wey fit receive am, make e receive am.”
Den dem bring small pikin dem to am, so that e go lay im hands on dem and pray; and di disciples rebuke dem.
But Jesus talk say, “Allow di small pikin dem, and no stop dem make dem come to me; because Kingdom of Heaven belong to people like dem.”
E lay im hands on dem, and leave from dat place.
Look, one come to am and talk say, “Good teacher, wetin good thing I go do, so that I go get life wey no dey end?”
E talk say to am, “Why you dey call me good? Nobody good except one, dat na God. But if you want enter life, keep di commandments.”
E talk say to am, “Which ones?” Jesus talk say, “‘You no go murder.’ ‘You no go commit adultery.’ ‘You no go steal.’ ‘You no go give false testimony.’”
“‘Honor your papa and your mama.’ And, ‘You go love your neighbor as yourself.’”
Di young man talk say to am, “I don keep all dis things from my youth. Wetin I still lack?”
Jesus talk say to am, “If you want be perfect, go, sell wetin you get and give to di poor, and you go get treasure for heaven. Come, follow me.”
But when di young man hear di saying, e leave sad, because e na one wey get great possessions.
Jesus talk say to im disciples, “Most certainly I tell una say e hard for rich man to enter Kingdom of Heaven.”
“Again I tell una, e easy pass for camel to pass through needle eye, than for rich man to enter God Kingdom.”
When di disciples hear am, dem dey very astonished, dey talk say, “Den who fit dey saved?”
Jesus look dem, and talk say, “With men dis one impossible, but with God all things possible.”
Den Peter answer, “Look, we don leave everything, and follow you. Wetin den we go get?”

Jesus talk say to dem, “Most certainly I tell una say una wey don follow me, for di regeneration when Son of Man go sit for di throne of im glory, una too go sit for 12 thrones, dey judge di 12 tribes of Israel.”
“Everyone wey don leave houses, or brothers, or sisters, or papa, or mama, or wife, or pikin, or land, because of my name, go receive 100 times more, and go inherit life wey no dey end.”
“But plenty wey dey first go be last; and wey dey last go be first.”
“Because Kingdom of Heaven be like man wey na oga of household, wey come out early for morning to hire laborers for im vineyard.”
“When e don agree with di laborers for one denarius for day, e send dem enter im vineyard.”
“E come out about di third hour, and see others dey stand idle for di marketplace.”
“To dem e talk say, ‘Una too go enter di vineyard, and whatever right I go give una.’ So dem go dem way.”
“Again e come out about di sixth and di ninth hour, and do di same.”
“About di 11th hour e come out, and find others dey stand idle. E talk say to dem, ‘Why una dey stand here all day idle?’”
“Dem talk say to am, ‘Because nobody don hire us.’ E talk say to dem, ‘Una too go enter di vineyard, and una go receive whatever right.’”
“When evening don come, di oga of di vineyard talk say to im steward, ‘Call di laborers and pay dem dem wages, begin from di last go reach di first.’”
“When dem wey dem hire about di 11th hour come, dem each receive one denarius.”
“When di first ones come, dem suppose say dem go receive more; and dem too each receive one denarius.”
“When dem receive am, dem complain against di oga of di household,”
“Dem talk say, ‘Dis last ones spend one hour, and you don make dem equal to us, wey don bear di burden of di day and di scorching heat!’”
“But e answer one of dem, ‘Friend, I no dey do you wrong. You no agree with me for one denarius?’”
“‘Take wetin belong to you, and go your way. Na my desire to give dis last one, just as to you.’”
“‘E no lawful for me to do wetin I want with wetin I own? Or your eye dey evil, because I good?’”
“So di last go be first, and di first last. Because plenty dey called, but few dey chosen.”
As Jesus dey go up to Jerusalem, e take di 12 disciples aside for di way, and talk say to dem,
“Look, we dey go up to Jerusalem, and dem go hand Son of Man over to di chief priests and scribes. Dem go condemn am to death,”
“and go hand am over to di Gentiles to mock, to flog, and to crucify. For di third day dem go raise am up.”
Den di mama of Zebedee pikin dem come to am with im sons, dey kneel and dey ask am for something.
E talk say to am, “Wetin you want?” E talk say to am, “Command say dis two my sons go sit, one for your right hand, and one for your left hand, for your Kingdom.”
But Jesus answer, “Una no know wetin una dey ask. Una fit drink di cup wey I dey about to drink, and to dey baptize with di baptism wey dem baptize me with?” Dem talk say to am, “We fit.”

E talk say to dem, “Una go drink my cup indeed, and dem go baptize una with di baptism wey dem baptize me with; but to sit for my right hand and for my left hand no be mine to give, but na for dem wey dem don prepare am for by my Papa God.”
When di ten hear am, dem dey indignant with di two brothers.
But Jesus call dem, and talk say, “Una know say di rulers of di nations dey rule over dem like oga dem, and dem great ones dey exercise authority over dem.”
“E no go be so among una, but whoever want become great among una go be una servant.”
“Whoever want be first among una go be una bondservant,”
“even as Son of Man no come to dey served but to serve, and to give im life as ransom for plenty.”
As dem dey leave Jericho, great multitude follow am.
Look, two blind men dey sit by di road, when dem hear say Jesus dey pass by, dem cry out, “Lord, show us mercy, you David pikin!”
Di multitude rebuke dem, dey tell dem make dem quiet, but dem cry out more, “Lord, show us mercy, you David pikin!”
Jesus stand still, and call dem, and ask, “Wetin una want make I do for una?”
Dem tell am, “Lord, make our eyes open.”
Jesus, as compassion move am, touch dem eyes; and immediately dem eyes receive sight, and dem follow am.
